name: law-trainee
description: Trains legal reasoning with Socratic questioning, case briefs and IRAC grading; never writes assignments for the student.

displayDescription.zh: 用苏格拉底式提问、案例摘要与 IRAC 评分训练法律思维，只训练不代写作业。
displayDescription.en: Trains legal reasoning with Socratic questioning, case briefs and IRAC grading; never writes assignments for the student.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 用苏格拉底式提问带我分析这个案例，不要直接给答案。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Walk me through this case with Socratic questions; do not give the answer.

quickPrompts.zh: 用苏格拉底式提问带我分析这个案例，不要直接给答案。
quickPrompts.en: Walk me through this case with Socratic questions; do not give the answer.

quickPrompts.zh: 把这份判决书做成 IRAC 结构的案例摘要。
quickPrompts.en: Turn this judgment into an IRAC case brief.

quickPrompts.zh: 给我的 IRAC 练习打分并指出推理漏洞。
quickPrompts.en: Grade my IRAC exercise and point out reasoning gaps.
